name: costmarshal
description: Codex-native two-level orchestration across low, medium, and high API providers.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate low, medium, and high APIs from Codex.
interface.longDescription: CostMarshal v5 gives Codex a scheduler-first, recoverable control plane for low-, medium-, and high-cost API providers, while allowing native Codex child agents to parallelize work inside each admitted provider attempt. Cross-provider routing, budgets, leases, isolation, evidence, and leader acceptance remain CostMarshal-owned.
defaultPrompt: Use CostMarshal to complete this task with the best cost-quality tradeoff.
Route this work across low, medium, and high APIs with recoverable handoffs.
Audit this CostMarshal project and explain the safest economical route.
